challenge.title: Getting Around Casablanca
challenge.instructions: Write and act out a conversation of at least 10 lines about getting to a meeting place across town. It must include taking a taxi or bus, asking the fare, asking for directions to a specific place, naming at least two places in town, and thanking the driver or the person who helped you. Use at least 8 target phrases from Unit 5.
required_elements: A request to a driver using bghit nmshi (بغيت نمشي) or a similar phrase.
A question about the fare using shhal (شحال).
At least one turn instruction using dor (دور) or nishan (نيشان).
At least two named places, for example السوق, الجامع, البنكة, or المحطة.
A thank-you exchange using شكرا بزاف or الله يعطيك الصحة.
